newsitem.title: HONG KONG: EBRD launches 23.7 bln won offshore bond issue.
newsitem.headline: EBRD launches 23.7 bln won offshore bond issue.

text.p: The following issue was announced by lead manager Merrill Lynch International.
The bond is the offshore tranche of a bond totalling 94.8 billion Korean won.
Details are as follows:
BORROWER EUROPEAN BANK FOR RECONSTRUCTION AND DEVELOPMENT
AMT 23.7 BLN WON COUPON 10 PCT MATURITY 02.MAY.02
TYPE EUROBOND YIELD * PAY DATE 02.MAY.97
LAST MOODY AAA ISS PRICE 100.25 LAUNCH 14.APR.97
LAST S&P AAA REOFFER 100.25 FULL FEES 40BP
LISTING SEOUL DENOMS 10,100 MLN KRW
SALE LIMITS US/UK/HK/SOUTH KOREA
NEG PLEDGE YES CROSS DEF YES FORCE MAJ IPMA2**
MGT/UND 15BP SELL CONC 25BP PAY FREQ SEMI
GOV LAW KOREAN HOME CTRY SUPRANATIONAL
NOTES - *YIELDS 9.935 PCT SEMI-ANNUALLY, 10.182 PCT ANNUALLY
**MODIFIED IPMA2
SETTLEMENT VIA EUROCLEAR, CEDEL
ALL PAYMENTS TO BE SETTLED IN U.S. DOLLARS. THE BONDS
INITIALLY WILL BE SETTLED AT A RATE OF US$1 PER 896.40
WON. ALL SUBSEQUENT PAYMENTS WILL BE CALCULATED USING
THE APPLICABLE USD/KRW SPOT FX RATE SET ONE DAY PRIOR
WITH REFERENCE TO THE REUTERS SCREEN KFTC18.
LEADS MERRILL LYNCH INTERNATIONAL (BOOKRUNNER), KDB
SECURITIES. A GROUP IS BEING FORMED.
-- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843-6371
